_doc: Read by smoke_check.py (build.ps1 -Smoke). tool_counts: tools/list length per engine and registration mode (default = all tools except assess-needed-tools; dynamic = bEnableDynamicToolDiscovery, assess-needed-tools only; python_only = bEnablePythonScriptOnlyMode, run-python and the six script-library tools). A card that adds or removes an MCP tool updates the default counts. known_failures: per engine, a list of {check, ids, why} for failures already present at a commit; check is the exact check name smoke_check.py prints, and the card that fixes the finding removes the entry. Probe statuses live in Tests/mcp_probe/expected.json.
